title: HB139 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to concealed deadly weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb139/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3043909))
provenance.note: Introduced print (no date on the print); no passage vote in the data, so it is the bill as filed. Age 21 is struck and 18 added in KRS 237.109(1) and KRS 237.110(1)(c). Other changes in Section 2 are punctuation only.

operative_text:
Section 1 (KRS 237.109): (1) Persons age eighteen (18) or older, and otherwise able to lawfully possess a firearm, may carry concealed firearms or other concealed deadly weapons without a license in the same locations as persons with valid licenses issued under KRS 237.110.
